verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a public REST API callable from cURL or Postman and a Python SDK for partitioning, enriching, chunking and embedding. Its documented workflow and job APIs let users create, update, run and delete workflows, and trigger runs, monitor status and download results. A llms.txt probe returned agent-oriented guidance to the SDK and API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
